rule.message: Permanent project constraint: Bash commands whose first executable is npm must be blocked; use pnpm instead.

evidence.quote: Permanent project constraint: Bash commands whose first executable is npm must be blocked; use pnpm instead. This is a durable rule for subsequent tasks, not a one-turn preference.
evidence.observation: User explicitly declares a lasting project-wide execution constraint on the npm command family, with pnpm as the substitute.

report.summary: Block Bash invocations whose first executable token is npm so the project's pnpm-only toolchain convention is enforced executably; pnpm, non-npm commands and mere text mentions of npm remain unaffected.

Scope limits: anchored to the leading executable with ASCII horizontal separators only (so CR/NBSP/newline-separated words are not shell argument boundaries here); no observed npm invocation occurred in this task slice, and env/interpreter prefixes such as NODE_ENV=test npm ci or pnpm exec npm test stay outside this selector rather than being silently claimed as covered.
